title: Naming & tagging convention compliance
description: Detects resources that violate organizational naming standards and required tag policies, impacting automation, cost allocation, and operational clarity.
example_prompt: "Check all resources against: (1) naming convention regex per resource type: VMs='{vm_pattern}', RGs='{rg_pattern}', Storage='{storage_pattern}'; (2) required tags: 'Environment', 'CostCenter', 'Owner', 'Application'. Show resources not matching patterns and those missing required tags. Prioritize production resources and sort by monthly cost."
